meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Exchange rate of the rupee, high and low during the month (DBIE report 583)
meta.coverage: How far the rupee swung within each month: highest and lowest rates
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 583. Two layouts kept as separate series: buying and selling highs and lows (1993 to 2012) and the reference-rate high and low (2008 on). Zeros in the old layout mean 'not quoted' and are left empty.
